startingCard.title: Northrop B-2 Spirit first flies
startingCard.subtitle: Aircraft by Northrop
startingCard.fact: The Northrop B-2 Spirit is an American nuclear-capable subsonic stealth strategic bomber, often referred to as a "stealth bomber".

cards.title: ‘Arrival’ is released
cards.subtitle: Film directed by Denis Villeneuve
cards.fact: Arrival is a 2016 American science fiction drama film directed by Denis Villeneuve and written by Eric Heisserer, based on the 1998 novella "Story of Your Life" by Ted Chiang.

cards.title: ‘Can't Be Tamed’ is released
cards.subtitle: Album by Miley Cyrus
cards.fact: Can't Be Tamed is the third studio album by American singer Miley Cyrus.

cards.title: ‘Black Desert’ releases
cards.subtitle: Video game by Pearl Abyss
cards.fact: Black Desert Online is a sandbox-oriented fantasy massively multiplayer online role-playing game (MMORPG) developed by Korean video game developer Pearl Abyss and originally published for Microsoft Windows in 2015.

cards.title: ‘Pac-Man’ releases
cards.subtitle: Video game by Namco
cards.fact: Pac-Man, originally titled Puck Man in Japan, is a 1980 maze video game developed and published by Namco for arcades.

cards.title: T-84 enters service
cards.subtitle: Ukrainian main battle tank based on the Soviet T-80
cards.fact: The T-84 is a Ukrainian main battle tank (MBT), based on the Soviet T-80 MBT introduced in 1976, specifically the diesel engine version: T-80UD.

cards.title: Philip Seymour Hoffman dies
cards.subtitle: American actor
cards.fact: Philip Seymour Hoffman was an American actor.

cards.title: ‘RapidShare’ launches
cards.subtitle: Website
cards.fact: RapidShare was an online file hosting service that opened in 2002.

cards.title: ‘Their Satanic Majesties Request’ is released
cards.subtitle: Album by The Rolling Stones
cards.fact: Their Satanic Majesties Request is the sixth studio album by the English rock band the Rolling Stones, released in December 1967 by Decca Records in the UK and by London Records in the United States.

cards.title: ‘Deathloop’ releases
cards.subtitle: Video game by Arkane Studios
cards.fact: Deathloop is a 2021 first-person shooter game developed by Arkane Lyon and published by Bethesda Softworks.

cards.title: Slimane of Morocco becomes sultan of Morocco
cards.fact: Mawlay Sulayman bin Mohammed, born on 28 June 1766 in Tafilalt and died on 28 November 1822 in Marrakesh, was a Sultan of Morocco from 1792 to 1822, as a ruler of the 'Alawi dynasty.

cards.title: Statue of Liberty is created
cards.subtitle: American icon in New York, United States
cards.fact: The Statue of Liberty is a colossal neoclassical sculpture of a robed and crowned woman on Liberty Island in New York Harbor, within New York City, U.S.

cards.title: Erich Kästner dies
cards.subtitle: German children's writer
cards.fact: Emil Erich Kästner was a German writer, poet, screenwriter and satirist, known primarily for his humorous, socially astute poems and for children's books including Emil and the Detectives and Lisa and Lottie.

cards.title: Lockheed U-2 first flies
cards.subtitle: Aircraft by Lockheed Corporation
cards.fact: The Lockheed U-2, nicknamed the "Dragon Lady", is an American single-engine, high–altitude reconnaissance aircraft operated by the United States Air Force (USAF) and the Central Intelligence Agency (CIA) since the 1950s.

cards.title: Woodrow Wilson becomes president of the United States
cards.fact: Thomas Woodrow Wilson was the 28th president of the United States, serving from 1913 to 1921.

cards.title: ‘Star Fox’ releases
cards.subtitle: Video game by Nintendo Entertainment Analysis & Development
cards.fact: Star Fox, known as Starwing in PAL regions, is a 1993 rail shooter game developed by Nintendo and Argonaut Software, and published by Nintendo for the Super Nintendo Entertainment System (SNES).

cards.title: ‘Akalabeth: World of Doom’ releases
cards.subtitle: Video game by Richard Garriott
cards.fact: Akalabeth: World of Doom is a role-playing video game created in 1979 for the Apple II by Richard Garriott, and published by California Pacific Computer Company in 1980.

cards.title: Faisal Mosque is completed
cards.subtitle: Mosque in Islamabad
cards.fact: The Faisal Mosque is the national mosque of Pakistan, located in Islamabad, the capital of the country.

cards.title: George Carlin dies
cards.subtitle: American stand-up comedian
cards.fact: George Denis Patrick Carlin was an American stand-up comedian, social critic, actor and author.

cards.title: ‘Hello Neighbor’ releases
cards.subtitle: Video game
cards.fact: Hello Neighbor is a stealth horror game developed by Dynamic Pixels and published by tinyBuild.

cards.title: ‘The Knights’ premieres
cards.subtitle: Play by Aristophanes
cards.fact: The Knights was the fourth play written by Aristophanes, who is considered the master of Old Comedy.

cards.title: ‘In Rainbows’ is released
cards.subtitle: Album by Radiohead
cards.fact: In Rainbows is the seventh studio album by the English rock band Radiohead.

cards.title: Boston Massacre takes place
cards.subtitle: American Revolution
cards.fact: The Boston Massacre, known in Great Britain as the Incident on King Street, was a confrontation on March 5, 1770 during the American Revolution in Boston in what was then the colonial-era Province of Massachusetts Bay.

cards.title: OxygenOS is released
cards.subtitle: Operating System
cards.fact: OxygenOS is an Android-based operating system (OS) developed by Chinese smartphone manufacturer OnePlus exclusively for their smartphones.

cards.title: Golden State Warriors is founded
cards.subtitle: NBA franchise
cards.fact: The Golden State Warriors are an American professional basketball team based in San Francisco.

cards.title: ‘Quake 4’ releases
cards.subtitle: Video game by Raven Software
cards.fact: Quake 4 is a 2005 first-person shooter game developed by Raven Software and published by Activision.

cards.title: Chelsea F.C. is founded
cards.subtitle: Football club
cards.fact: Chelsea Football Club is an English professional football club based in Fulham, West London, England.

cards.title: Joseph Goebbels becomes chancellor of Germany
cards.fact: Paul Joseph Goebbels was a German politician and philologist who was the Gauleiter of Berlin, chief propagandist for the Nazi Party, and then Reich Minister of Propaganda from 1933 until his suicide in 1945.

cards.title: ‘Victim of Love’ is released
cards.subtitle: Album by Elton John
cards.fact: Victim of Love is the thirteenth studio album by British musician Elton John.

cards.title: ‘World of Tanks’ releases
cards.subtitle: Video game by Wargaming
cards.fact: World of Tanks (WoT) is an armoured warfare-themed multiplayer online game developed by Wargaming, featuring 20th century (1910s–1970s) era combat vehicles.

cards.title: Malcolm I of Scotland becomes king of Scotland
cards.fact: Máel Coluim mac Domnaill was king of Alba, becoming king when his cousin Constantine II abdicated to become a monk.
